title: German Green Steel and Power — opening
script: It is 1976, and you are standing in a scrapyard in Ahmedabad. The air smells of metal and dust, and a man named Shamsulhaq Iraki is weighing a sack of iron scrap by hand, and calling out the number to a buyer. Now, he doesn't know it yet, but his sons will one day take a company public that turns that same scrap into the steel rods inside India's highways and high-rises.
